Metric: max(|residual bias| + U_k2) at declared uncertainty points
Notes: Applies to four declared uncertainty-evaluation points; includes C1 offset-estimation uncertainty.

Metric: pooled/common-sigma 95% UCL; strict worst-condition rule unspecified
Notes: Pooled SD=0.2593 %RH; one-sided 95% common-sigma UCL=0.2629 %RH with df=7080. Maximum sample SD=0.3192 %RH is descriptive only; a valid simultaneous worst-condition decision rule is not defined by the public specification.

Metric: maximum matched |UP mean error - DOWN mean error|
Notes: C1 offset cancels in matched direction difference. PASS has a narrow 0.075 %RH observed margin; no formal guard-band decision rule is defined.

Metric: max RH-level mean residual deviation from best-fit line
Notes: METHOD-DEFINED: public spec does not define endpoint vs best-fit linearity.

Metric: command-to-DUT t90 with reference adequacy check
Notes: DUT mean t90=112.0s, max=122.9s; reference mean t90=78.4s; mean DUT-reference lag=33.7s. Reference/chamber stimulus itself is slower than the 60s DUT limit.

Metric: public absolute band only; no maximum settling time specified
Notes: No binary time-to-settle acceptance criterion is publicly defined.

Metric: 90-day stability evidence; annualized slope diagnostic only
Notes: 90-day campaign; non-monotonic maximum center excursion=0.5025 %RH. Annualized slope is not used as a compliance extrapolation.
